title: Repository mutation success is proven by the live target ref
failure_signature: An automation/comment reports PASS although the intended branch HEAD did not move to the reported repair, or correctness is claimed before live CI exists for that target SHA.
root_cause: Success was inferred from a local checkout, local diff, or narrative receipt instead of re-reading the authoritative remote target ref and live CI state.
invariant: A repo-mutating automation must report the exact pushed SHA, and acceptance must re-read the live target branch/PR HEAD and verify that SHA. Correctness claims additionally require live CI. Bot comments and local logs are receipts, never implementation authority.
anti_regression: Do not infer a successful push from `git diff HEAD^ HEAD`, a local commit, or a PASS comment.
Do not let checkpoint prose or automation output outrank the live Git graph/HEAD/CI.

guards.description: Normative cold-start route requires the fresh Agent to refresh live HEAD/delta/CI before executing persisted continuation state.

revisit_when: Only revisit if repository mutation is moved behind a stronger transactional authority that can atomically prove the target ref update and its verification result.
